lines.text: {"op":"add","path":"/elements/page-description","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Choose your dates, find your favorite room, and make your stay your own.","variant":"lead"},"children":[]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/elements/dates-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"1. Plan your stay","description":"Check-in from 3 PM · Check-out by 11 AM"},"children":["dates-grid"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/check-out","value":{"type":"Input","props":{"label":"Check-out","name":"checkOut","placeholder":"YYYY-MM-DD","value":{"$bindState":"/booking/checkOut"},"checks":[{"type":"required","message":"Enter a check-out date."},{"type":"pattern","message":"Use YYYY-MM-DD.","args":{"pattern":"^\\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])$"}},{"type":"greaterThan","message":"Check-out must be after check-in.","args":{"other":{"$state":"/booking/checkIn"}}}]},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/rooms-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"2. Find your room","description":"All rooms include Wi-Fi, locally roasted coffee, and organic bath essentials."},"children":["room-list","room-select"]}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/rooms/0","value":{"id":"classic","name":"Classic Queen","description":"A cozy retreat with one queen bed and a courtyard view.","rate":"$189 / night · Sleeps 2"}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/rooms/1","value":{"id":"deluxe","name":"Deluxe King","description":"Stretch out with a king bed, reading nook, and city views.","rate":"$249 / night · Sleeps 2"}}
{"op":"add","path":"/state/rooms/2","value":{"id":"suite","name":"Cedar Suite","description":"A spacious suite with a king bed and separate living area.","rate":"$349 / night · Sleeps 3"}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/room-select","value":{"type":"Select","props":{"label":"Your room type","name":"roomType","options":["Classic Queen","Deluxe King","Cedar Suite"],"value":{"$bindState":"/booking/roomType"},"checks":[{"type":"required","message":"Choose a room type."}]},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/extras-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"3. Add a little extra","description":"Optional touches for an easier getaway. Prices in USD."},"children":["breakfast","parking","late-checkout"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/guest-card","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"4. Guest details","description":"Your booking confirmation will use these details."},"children":["guest-name","guest-email"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/guest-email","value":{"type":"Input","props":{"label":"Email address","name":"guestEmail","type":"email","value":{"$bindState":"/booking/guestEmail"},"checks":[{"type":"required","message":"Enter your email address."},{"type":"email","message":"Enter a valid email address."}]},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/booking-summary","value":{"type":"Card","props":{"title":"Your getaway","description":"Review your stay before confirming.","className":"h-fit lg:sticky lg:top-6"},"children":["summary-room","summary-dates","summary-rate","summary-divider","summary-extras-title","summary-breakfast","summary-parking","summary-late","pricing-note","terms","confirm-button","confirmation"]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/summary-rate","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":{"$cond":{"$state":"/booking/roomType","eq":"Classic Queen"},"$then":"$189 per night","$else":{"$cond":{"$state":"/booking/roomType","eq":"Deluxe King"},"$then":"$249 per night","$else":"$349 per night"}},"variant":"lead"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/pricing-note","value":{"type":"Text","props":{"text":"Sample rates include taxes. This demo records your selection only; it does not reserve a room or charge a payment.","variant":"caption"},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/terms","value":{"type":"Checkbox","props":{"label":"I have reviewed my dates, room, and extras.","name":"reviewed","checked":{"$bindState":"/booking/reviewed"},"checks":[{"type":"required","message":"Review your stay and tick this box to continue."}]},"children":[]}}

{"op":"add","path":"/elements/confirmation","value":{"type":"Alert","props":{"title":"Your selection is confirmed","message":{"$template":"Thanks, ${/booking/guestName}. Your ${/booking/roomType} selection for ${/booking/checkIn} to ${/booking/checkOut} is saved in this demo."},"type":"success"},"visible":{"$state":"/bookingValidation/valid","eq":true},"watch":{"/booking":{"action":"setState","params":{"statePath":"/bookingValidation/valid","value":false}}},"children":[]}}
